lastCompletedStory.title: Ensure-up idempotent container lifecycle at supervisor boot

nextStoryContext: ensureWorkerContainer() is now in src/supervisor/ensure-container.ts. It reconciles container state across 4 branches (running/stopped/absent/image-stale) using DI spawnFn+probe seams. makeProductionEnsureContainerFn(cwd) builds the production closure. Wired in runSidecar() via options.ensureContainerFn with gate readWorkerIsolation()==='container'. cam stop still has 0 docker references. Next story (US-004 or later) may wire dockerExecWrap() into dispatch sites (loop.ts) gated on WorkerIsolation=container.

officialDocsValidated.summary: docker inspect -f {{.State.Running}} returns 'true' for running containers, 'false' for stopped containers, and exits non-zero for absent containers. Confirmed by official docs and Docker CLI discussions. Implementation matches expected behavior.
